title: Bless TV Anime Casts Kentarō Kumagai
content: The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed in a character promotional video on Thursday that Kentarō Kumagai will voice MM in the series.
author: ANN

title: Grandgear Film by Godzilla Minus One's Takashi Yamazaki Opens in January 2028
content: Sony Pictures announced on Wednesday that Godzilla Minus One director Takashi Yamazaki 's first English-language film Grandgear has moved up its release date from February 18, 2028 to January 14, 2028. Yamazaki is writing the original screenplay, directing the film, and producing. Bad Robot's J.J.

title: Seiji Ebisu's Bishōjo shika Inai Seitokai no Gidai ga Itsumo Ore na Ken Novel Gets Manga Adaptation
content: The 157th issue of Kadokawa 's Dengeki Daioh G magazine launched the manga adaptation of Seiji Ebisu 's Bishōjo shika Inai Seitokai no Gidai ga Itsumo Ore na Ken (The Case of Me Always Being the Topic of Discussion of the Student Council, Which Only Has Beautiful Girls as Members) novel, on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo Anime's New Video Previews Ending Song
content: The staff for the television anime of Shun Numa 's Super Psychic Policeman Chojo ( Chōjun! Chōjō Senpai ) manga started streaming a new promotional video on Thursday, which features the anime's ending theme song "Mata Ashita" (See You Tomorrow) by Shifuku Poncho .
author: ANN

title: Battle in 5 Seconds Manga Resumes
content: Miyakokasiwa 's Battle in 5 Seconds ( Deatte 5-byō de Battle ) manga (a remake of Saizō Harawata 's original series) resumed on Thursday. Shogakukan had posted the previous chapter on June 11, and the author announced the hiatus on August 13. The manga went on hiatus due to Miyakokasiwa struggling with poor health.
author: ANN

title: OceanVeil Announces Simulcast Stream of My Girlfriend's Friend Anime
content: OceanVeil announced on Thursday that it will simultaneously stream the anime of Jura 's My Girlfriend's Friend ( Kanojo no Tomodachi ) manga, starting on October 4. OceanVeil describes the anime's story: Takeru Hidaka thought he had found simple happiness with his sweet, cheerful first girlfriend, Kaori.
author: ANN

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Streams Teaser Video
content: The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, started streaming the anime's teaser promotional video on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Netflix to Stream Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime
content: Netflix announced on Thursday that it will stream the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series. The service will stream the anime in the United States on October 17. The anime is listed to start streaming on October 14 in selected areas/countries.
author: ANN

title: Yasuaki Mikami's Looks like a Job for a Maid! Light Novels Get TV Anime
content: Earth Star Novel announced on Thursday that Yasuaki Mikami 's Looks like a Job for a Maid! The Tales of a Dismissed Supermaid ( Maid Nara Tōzen Desu. Nureginu o Kiserareta Bannō Maid-san wa Tabi ni Deru Koto ni Shimashita ) light novel series is getting a television anime adaptation.
author: ANN

title: New Obocchama-kun Anime Airs on TV in Japan in 2027 (Updated)
content: TV Asahi announced on Thursday that the new Indian-animated Obocchama-kun show based on Yoshinori Kobayashi 's Obocchama-kun manga will air in Japan in 2027 under the title Obocchama-kun Reborn .
author: ANN
